headline: Chilean Economy Contracts 1.1% in Third Quarter
summary: Chile's economy contracted 1.1% in the third quarter, with cumulative contraction reaching 0.5% between January and September. Investment fell 6.7%, driven largely by a downturn in the mining sector.
why: Gross Domestic Product figures measure overall economic activity and guide central bank monetary policy. Declining investment and mining output point to structural pressures in South America's major copper-producing economy.

impacts.name: Chile
impacts.why: A contraction in quarterly GDP and falling investment reflect slowing domestic economic activity.
